name: The Best of Captain America
description: Deliberately out of publication order, this opens in Ed Brubaker's spy-thriller years and later doubles back to the Red Skull's classics. Brubaker's Captain America leads through Reborn and Rebirth to Man Out of Time by Mark Waid. Captain America and Bucky follows, then Tales of Suspense, The Life and Times of the Red Skull and Gruenwald's The Captain.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
